email.body1:
Arvind, saw Incode just landed the Interac partnership and is raising at a $3B valuation.

Expanding strategic accounts that fast usually means more enterprise targets in play than reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Incode off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Arvind, quick follow-up for Incode.

With a raise and a marquee partner in hand, expectations on strategic pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Incode's strategic team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Arvind, last bit of proof for Incode.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Incode's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth identity startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Arvind, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a raise and a big partner win, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise identity motion? I will tailor it to Incode either way.
